normalization.field_spectrum: raw unscaled selected complex bins; point,frequency axes
normalization.echo_spectrum: raw unscaled full one-sided bins; frequency,element axes
normalization.rf: irfft(conj(echo_spectrum), n=2*(Nf-1)); first half; PyMUST smooth threshold

notes: Parameters include explicitly recorded effective defaults TXfreqsweep=None and RXdelay=zeros; ParPool defaults false.
pfield3 adds RC=None internally; simus3 sets RC to fixture reflectivity, CallFun=simus3, and FrequencyStep to its computed absolute frequency bound.
Both calls receive fresh deep copies; no extra receive delays or coherent transmit rows.
